market_view: Risk-on morning: Trump calls the Iran war 'effectively over', crude falls again, European index futures and drivers point up and VIX drops 22%, with US CPI later today as the main event risk. The only fresh, name-specific, low-cost catalyst is Infineon's record Q4 and FY2027 guidance above forecasts; everything else is macro continuation, routine buybacks or an approval that was likely expected.
would_change_my_mind: A hot US CPI print that hits chips broadly, or the Infineon earnings call shifting tone toward the cash-flow miss, would make me close or not add to IFX.DE.

oil_gas.reasoning: The only catalyst is negative for the group (Iran de-escalation, Brent -1.58%); the Equinor buyback tranche is routine and too small to clear about 2% round-trip cost.

gold_miners.catalyst: none - no headline names EDV.L or FRES.L
gold_miners.reasoning: No name-specific catalyst, mixed gold signals ahead of US CPI, and UK names cost about 3.3% round trip.

chips.catalyst: Infineon closes FY 2026 with record quarter; expects revenue growth of more than 20 percent and a 5-percentage-point increase in profitability for FY 2027 - marketscreener (corroborated by Bloomberg and WSJ 'Lifts AI Sales Goal') - 2026-11-10
chips.reasoning: A fresh beat-and-raise with guidance above forecasts at the lowest-cost name (0.89% entry, about 1.8% round trip) gives a reasonable case for post-earnings drift; the cash-flow miss and a likely gap at the open keep confidence only just above the bar, so the size is 6 shares rather than 7 to stay under the 35% cap if it opens higher.

pharma.catalyst: Bayer brings factor XIa to US stroke prevention with FDA nod for 1st-in-class asundexian - Fierce Pharma - 2026-11-10
pharma.reasoning: The Bayer approval is specific and new, but a scheduled FDA decision was likely expected and bleeding-risk questions remain, so 0.50 is below the bar; the Novo label warning is negative and probably largely priced.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none - headlines are generic supply commentary; SMM reports weak South China consumption
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper is flat with contradicting demand signals and no name-specific catalyst.

handoff.what_changed: Infineon reported a record Q4 and guided FY2027 revenue growth above 20% with higher profitability, above forecasts; I sent a buy of 6 IFX.DE for a 10-day horizon. Trump said the Iran war is 'effectively over' and crude fell again; Bayer won FDA approval for asundexian and the FDA ordered a blindness warning on GLP-1 drugs. US CPI is due today; the BofA chip downgrade names were still not confirmed by any item in today's brief.
